scripts.load-chrome: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); const manifest=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('manifest.json')); if(!manifest.web_accessible_resources[0].resources.includes('assets/js/jsdom.js')){manifest.web_accessible_resources[0].resources.push('assets/js/jsdom.js'); fs.writeFileSync('manifest.json', JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)); console.log('Added jsdom.js to manifest for Chrome')} else {console.log('jsdom.js already in manifest')}"
scripts.load-firefox: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(!fs.existsSync('manifest.chrome.json')){fs.copyFileSync('manifest.json','manifest.chrome.json'); console.log('Chrome manifest backed up')}; const manifest=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('manifest.firefox.json')); const idx=manifest.web_accessible_resources[0].resources.indexOf('assets/js/jsdom.js'); if(idx>-1){manifest.web_accessible_resources[0].resources.splice(idx,1); fs.writeFileSync('manifest.json', JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2)); console.log('Removed jsdom.js from manifest for Firefox')} else {fs.copyFileSync('manifest.firefox.json','manifest.json'); console.log('Firefox manifest loaded')}"
scripts.restore-chrome: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); if(fs.existsSync('manifest.chrome.json')){const manifest=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync('manifest.chrome.json')); if(!manifest.web_accessible_resources[0].resources.includes('assets/js/jsdom.js')){manifest.web_accessible_resources[0].resources.push('assets/js/jsdom.js'); fs.writeFileSync('manifest.chrome.json', JSON.stringify(manifest, null, 2))} fs.copyFileSync('manifest.chrome.json','manifest.json'); console.log('Chrome manifest restored with jsdom.js')} else {console.log('manifest.chrome.json not found')}"
